0022600214.text: The Miami Heat (4-6, 8th in the East, 2 games back in the Southeast) visit the Utah Jazz (1-9, 15th in the West), who have lost eight straight and are 1-4 at home. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), Keyonte George (ankle sprain), and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain), all listed as out. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and Miami's most recent meeting was a 115-111 loss in Miami on February 9, 2026; this is their first meeting of 2026-27.
